parameters.content: Nightly cleanup for Dyzania LLP (fictional). Deletes ops_events and triage_log rows older than 90 days, at most 1000 per table per night, and never a row without a readable date. Nothing else is deleted: leads, bookings and court notices have no automatic deletion, and the code refuses any table that has no retention rule. The two tables are cleaned on separate branches so one cannot block the other. Delete nodes act only on the ids the Code node selected.
